 Get details on Bravo's first original scripted microdrama, Charmed by a Southern Monster , starring Craig Conover.
 By Brad Witter Oct 23, 2026, 11:00 AM ET Catch the Southern Charm Season 12 Trailer! Now Playing 2:26 Preview Catch the Southern Charm Season 12 Trailer! 2:04 Preview Craig Conover Accuses Charley Manley of “Love-Bombing” Him 2:09 Preview Andy Cohen Calls Craig Conover “Chaste” at the Southern Charm Reunion Share this on Reddit Share this on Facebook Share this on X Share this by Email Share this by SMS Copy link Add us on Google Key Takeaways
 Bravo has greenlit its first original scripted microdrama, Charmed by a Southern Monster , starring Craig Conover as Hunter Caldwell alongside Nicole Mattox as Maeve Marchant.
 The series follows a corporate fixer sent to persuade and seduce a rumored murderer into selling his family estate, leading to romance, hidden secrets, and a dangerous small-town mystery tied to a billion-dollar development deal.
 Charmed by a Southern Monster premieres Nov. 9 and will stream exclusively on the Peacock mobile app, with Craig Conover also expanding his acting career through his production company and upcoming film projects.
 Prepare to see Southern Charm 's Craig Conover flex his acting muscle, as Bravo's first original scripted microdrama, Charmed by a Southern Monster , has officially received a series greenlight.
 How to Watch
 Southern Charm premieres Thursday, November 12 at 9 p.m. EST/PST on Bravo. Episodes stream next day on Peacock.
 Stream on The news dropped on Oct. 23 ahead of Bravo Fan Fest 2026, with the official announcement teasing that the upcoming series "blends soapy romance, workplace rivalry, and small-town mystery."
 As you await Craig's Bravo microdrama debut, read on for everything to know about Charmed by a Southern Monster .
 Trending Shorts
https://www.bravotv.com/shorts/embedded/show/southern-charm
 Who is in the Charmed by a Southern Monster cast?
 Charmed by a Southern Monster stars Craig Conover as Hunter Caldwell and Nicole Mattox as Maeve Marchant.
 What is Charmed by a Southern Monster about?
 "The story follows Maeve, a brilliant corporate fixer sent to convince and seduce Hunter, a rumored murderer, into selling his family's estate," the Oct. 23 press release revealed. "But when she discovers that the town's most feared man may actually be its most misunderstood, and the only person who can protect her from her dangerous ex-boyfriend, Maeve becomes entangled in Hunter's world. As family secrets and a billion-dollar development deal threaten to unravel their growing connection, she must confront her past and decide how much she's willing to risk for love."
 When does Charmed by a Southern Monster premiere?
 Charmed by a Southern Monster premieres on Monday, Nov. 9.

 Where can you watch Charmed by a Southern Monster ?
 Charmed by a Southern Monster will be available to stream exclusively on the Peacock mobile app.
 Is there a trailer for Charmed by a Southern Monster ?
 No, there is not currently a trailer available for Charmed by a Southern Monster .
 Bravo Fan Fest 2026: What to Know Bravo Fan Fest is back! The one-day event takes place on Saturday, October 24 in Charleston, South Carolina and will stream exclusively on Peacock . Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen will also be taping shows leading up to the event, on Thursday, Oct. 22, and Friday, Oct. 23.
 Stay up to date about all things Bravo Fan Fest 2026 here .
 What has Craig Conover said about his acting career?
 Craig, who previously announced the launch of his own production company , Plaid Horse Productions, in September 2025, recently opened up to Bravo Insider about his budding acting career . In addition to gushing about adding the title of "actor" to his growing resumé, Craig exclusively teased his role in an upcoming movie that's currently slated for a 2027 release.
 "I f--king love it," he said of his foray into acting. "It's because I always loved the production side of things, but I wanted to do more. I like that we shoot for 12 weeks, and it's great. I love the projects."
 RELATED: Bravo Fall 2026 Schedule: See the Full Lineup of Shows 
 As for his upcoming movie role, Craig teased, "I've got a niece in this movie, [who] is this 5-year-old who doesn't leave my side. And the 11-year-old girl is a star. Some actresses and actors I know of, and now we're all friends. It's been really cool."
 Not to worry, though: Craig, who is returning for Southern Charm Season 12 on Nov. 12, also promised that he's "not going anywhere," when it comes to reality TV. Even so, he added, "I've kind of had some really great meetings over the last two years with NBC and Rob Lowe. And I don't wanna go anywhere, but I wanna do more. I love this business ... They've been really supportive of me and just some scripted stuff, so it's fun."
 As you await Charmed by a Southern Monster , don't miss a sneak peek at what's ahead for Craig in the Southern Charm Season 12 trailer .
